---
title: "Lusha connector on Albato"
description: "How to connect Lusha to Albato and build automated workflows for contact and company enrichment."
---

The Lusha connector on Albato lets you enrich contacts and companies automatically as part of your Albato automation flows. You'll need a Lusha API key and an active Albato account to get started.

## How to connect Lusha to Albato

1. Log in to your [Albato account](https://albato.com/app/user/auth/login?lang=en) and go to the **Apps** section.

![Albato Apps section](data:image/png;base64,)

2. Click **Add a connection**.
3. Search for "Lusha", select it, then click **Add a connection** again.

![Search for Lusha and select the app](data:image/png;base64,)

4. Give your connection a name.

![Name your connection](data:image/png;base64,)

5. Get your Lusha API key from the [API section](https://dashboard.lusha.com/api) of your Lusha dashboard and copy it.
6. Paste the API key into the Albato connection field and click **Continue / Save**.

![Paste your Lusha API key](data:image/png;base64,)

Your connection is ready - you can now build Albato automations that use Lusha data.

## Common use cases

- **Lead enrichment** - when a new lead is created in your CRM, trigger Albato to call Lusha and enrich the contact with job title, company size, email, and phone
- **Company profiling** - fetch firmographic data (revenue, employee count) from Lusha when a new company record is added to your database
- **Automated outreach** - use enriched Lusha data to trigger personalised email or messaging flows when conditions are met (e.g., target role + company size)

## Tips

- Monitor your API usage in Lusha - each enrichment call consumes credits
- Map Lusha response fields carefully to your Albato workflow destinations
- Test your flows periodically, especially after platform updates
- Keep your API key secure and limit access where possible

For Albato-specific help, see the [Albato Help Center](https://wiki.albato.com/en). For Lusha API questions, see the [Lusha API documentation](https://docs.lusha.com) or contact support.
